Suresh Sah @ Suresh Lal Sah S/O Late Mohan Lal Sah 2. Rajiv Kumar Sah @ Raju Kumar S/O Suresh Lal Sah Both resident of Mohalla- Bara Bazar (Katihar), P.S., P.O. & District- Katihar .... .... Pe Versus The State Of Bihar .... .... Opposite Party/s =========================================================== Appearance : For the Petitioner/s : Mr. For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. =========================================================== Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Arun Kumar Oral Judgment
texts.arguments: Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners submits that only allegation against the petitioners is that they were engaged in selling sealed misbranded mustered oil under the label and wrapper of New Kishan Mustard Oil. He further submits that sample of seized mustered oil was sent to the Public Analyst for analysis and the report indicates no adulteration was found in the oil. Moreover in Patna High Court Cr.Misc. No.9217 of 2012 dt.03-07-2017 case of misbranding, the liability is not of the seller rather it is of the manufacturer. He further submits that on the same day, another prosecution case was launched against the petitioners with regard to seizure of misbranded pouch of Gutaka bearing Criminal Proceeding of B-III Case No. 03 of 2001 but the charge framed in the aforesaid case too was also [LEAKAGE_MASK] by a co-ordinate bench of this Court vide order dated 08.08.2012 passed in Cr. Misc. No. 1403 of 2012 holding therein that in case of misbranding the criminal liability is on the manufacturer and not on the shopkeeper.
texts.petitioner_arguments: Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners submits that only allegation against the petitioners is that they were engaged in selling sealed misbranded mustered oil under the label and wrapper of New Kishan Mustard Oil. He further submits that sample of seized mustered oil was sent to the Public Analyst for analysis and the report indicates no adulteration was found in the oil. Moreover in Patna High Court Cr.Misc. No.9217 of 2012 dt.03-07-2017 case of misbranding, the liability is not of the seller rather it is of the manufacturer. He further submits that on the same day, another prosecution case was launched against the petitioners with regard to seizure of misbranded pouch of Gutaka bearing Criminal Proceeding of B-III Case No. 03 of 2001 but the charge framed in the aforesaid case too was also [LEAKAGE_MASK] by a co-ordinate bench of this Court vide order dated 08.08.2012 passed in Cr. Misc. No. 1403 of 2012 holding therein that in case of misbranding the criminal liability is on the manufacturer and not on the shopkeeper.
